paper.title: Seek to Segment: Active Perception for Panoramic Referring Segmentation

evidence.section: Abstract; APRS benchmark construction and evaluation
evidence.figure_or_table: Benchmark overview and main evaluation tables
evidence.paraphrase: Active panoramic referring segmentation requires sequential viewpoint control, spatial-memory integration, target localization, and segmentation across continuous 360-degree scenes.

adjudication_notes: Retained as memory-adjacent because the primary benchmark contribution is active referring segmentation, with spatial memory serving the search process.
